newsitem.title: USA: Scios licensee sells blood test in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Scios licensee sells blood test in Japan.

text.p: Scios Inc said Tuesday its licensee in Japan, Shionogi and Co Ltd, has launched that country's first blood test for diagnosing and monitoring congestive heart failure.

The test, based on the detection of B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP) levels in the blood, was developed by Shionogi under a Scios license. It is used for hospital patients with acute heart failure or acute exacerbation of heart failure.
Scios said it was seeking additional licensees to develop BNP-based diagnostic tests for heart-failure applications in the rest of the world.
